issue: ESLint rule 'no-duplicate-component' referenced but no loading mechanism configured. ESLint will throw runtime error: 'Definition for rule not found'.
fix: Install eslint-plugin-local-rules and configure plugins entry, or use --rulesdir src/lib/rules in lint script

issue: Hardcoded email 'admin.demo@example.test' and password 'Demo@123456' in source code
fix: Use process.env.TEST_EMAIL and process.env.TEST_PASSWORD environment variables

issue: Hardcoded password 'Demo@123456' for mass-update of all credential accounts
fix: Read password from environment variable or CLI argument; add confirmation prompt; add env-guard against production

issue: Hardcoded plaintext password 'Demo@123456'
fix: Read from process.env.RESET_PASSWORD or CLI argument

issue: Invalid PowerShell here-string closing delimiter — '@" used instead of "@'
fix: Change closing delimiter from @" to "@

issue: Improper $ escaping in double-quoted here-string — backslash \ is not a PowerShell escape character
fix: Use backtick ` instead of backslash: db.`$disconnect() or switch to single-quoted here-string @'...'@

issue: Hardcoded email and password in source code
fix: Use process.env.TEST_EMAIL and process.env.TEST_PASSWORD from .env file (gitignored)

issue: Missing null check on query result 'a'. Accessing a.password throws TypeError if findFirst returns null
fix: Add null guard: if (!a) { console.error('No credential account found'); return db.$disconnect().then(() => process.exit(1)); }

issue: Prisma $disconnect() never called if any query fails — connection leak on exception
fix: Wrap body in try/catch/finally so $disconnect() always runs

issue: XSS vulnerability: function y constructs HTML via innerHTML without sanitization. Malicious script tags in source code will execute
fix: Use textContent instead of innerHTML for initial content, or sanitize before setting innerHTML

issue: Prototype chain pollution: user-controlled strings used as object keys without filtering __proto__ or constructor
fix: Add guard: if (aa === '__proto__' || aa === 'constructor' || aa === 'prototype') continue;

issue: Hardcoded plain-text password 'Demo@123456' — not hashed, exposed in source
fix: Use await hashPassword(process.env.DEMO_PASSWORD || 'Demo@123456')

issue: loginAs only logs warning when login fails but does NOT throw error. Tests silently pass with false positives
fix: throw new Error(`loginAs: Login failed for role "${role}"`) instead of console.warn

issue: No error handling for execSync or JSON.parse — either failure crashes process with unhandled exception
fix: Wrap in try/catch: catch execSync/JSON.parse errors and log + process.exit(1)

issue: include option placed outside findMany arguments due to misplaced closing brace. user is never eagerly loaded, acc.user.email throws TypeError
fix: Move closing brace to enclose include inside findMany arguments object

issue: acc.user.email throws 'Cannot read property email of undefined' because include is outside query args
fix: Fix misplaced closing brace so include is inside findMany args

issue: Login form lacks functional attributes — no action, method, name on inputs, or JS submit handlers. Forms are completely non-functional
fix: Add <form action="/api/auth/login" method="POST">, name/required attributes on inputs

issue: Column order mismatch in INSERT INTO new_LegalRequest SELECT * FROM LegalRequest causes silent data corruption — columns shifted by 2 positions
fix: List columns explicitly in INSERT: INSERT INTO "new_LegalRequest" (col1, col2, ...) SELECT col1, col2, ... FROM "LegalRequest"

issue: Index idx_vaultFileTag_tagId references non-existent table VaultFileTag — table was renamed to VaultItemTag
fix: Rename to CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_vaultItemTag_tagId ON "VaultItemTag" (tagId)

issue: deleteMany called BEFORE early-return check — if legalRequests is empty, all messages already deleted with no new messages created
fix: Move deleteMany after the legalRequests.length === 0 check, or wrap in transaction

issue: No idempotency — re-running seed fails with unique constraint violations on hardcoded IDs
fix: Use upsert instead of create for seed records: tx.tenant.upsert({ where: { id }, create: {...}, update: {} })

issue: Blanket vi.mock skip prevents next-intl mock from being added to any test file with ANY vi.mock call — silently breaks tests
fix: Check specifically for the mock line being inserted: if (content.includes(MOCK_LINE)) continue; instead of blanket skip

issue: Incorrect endedAt for older assignments — all get the most recent createdAt instead of the immediately-superseding one
fix: Use kindAssignments[i-1].createdAt for each assignment's endedAt instead of mostRecent.createdAt for all

issue: Missing parent directory creation — pathlib.Path.write_text() raises FileNotFoundError if parent dirs don't exist
fix: Add path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) before write_text()

issue: Data copy direction is wrong — comments say copy legacy -> _vi but code copies _vi -> _en, causing data corruption or no-op migration
fix: Align comments with actual code intent — verify migration direction and fix query/update to match

issue: Command injection via export $(cat .env.local | xargs) — shell metacharacters in .env.local execute arbitrary commands
fix: Use set -a; . ./.env.local; set +a or while IFS='=' read -r key value loop

issue: Missing dictionary fallback returns plain string instead of MultilingualString object — breaks type safety
fix: Return minimal multilingual object: { vi: '...', en: '...', zh: '...', ja: '...' } instead of plain string

issue: TypeError when RequestAssignment table is empty — 'isCurrent' in null throws. Non-null assertion ! doesn't protect at runtime
fix: Add null check before 'in' operator: if (!sampleAssignment || !('isCurrent' in sampleAssignment))

issue: Admin dashboard rendered as fallback for ANY authenticated user without specialist/reviewer roles — leaks all users, workspaces, audit events
fix: Add explicit isAdmin check before rendering admin dashboard: if (!isAdmin) throw new Error('Unauthorized')

issue: Header-based route permission bypass — x-pathname from client can be spoofed, bypassing canAccessRoute()
fix: Validate x-pathname against actual request path or use crypto-signed header from trusted middleware

issue: Missing authorization check — any authenticated user can view arbitrary organization data including member emails and requests
fix: Verify user belongs to organization: check organization membership or super_admin role

issue: Stats calculated from current page only (data.data) not full dataset — admin stat cards show misleading counts
fix: Use API-returned total counts or dedicated stats endpoint instead of computing from paginated data

issue: Stats computed from current page's data only — incorrect aggregated values on pages > 1
fix: Get stats from dedicated API endpoint or stats endpoint, not from paginated data

issue: Loading state conflates 'roles not yet loaded' with 'user has no roles' — user with no admin roles stuck on spinner forever
fix: Add loading/initialized flag to AdminRoleContext to distinguish init vs empty

issue: Missing admin authorization check — any logged-in user can access any user's details
fix:
Add if (!session.user?.isAdmin) return
Unauthorized

issue: 6 parallel Prisma queries without try/catch — any DB failure throws unhandled exception
fix: Wrap queries in try/catch and render error boundary or fallback UI

issue: Missing authorization check — session.roles never inspected. Any authenticated user including customers can access admin statistics
fix: Check session.roles includes at least one admin role (super_admin, audit_admin, coordinator_admin)

issue: Entire async server component has no try/catch — Prisma query failures crash with 500
fix: Wrap data fetching in try/catch and render user-friendly error state

issue: saveDraft and viewDraft buttons have no onClick handlers — completely non-functional
fix: Add formAction or onClick handlers to buttons

issue: Missing error handling on Promise.all — any DB failure causes unhandled rejection and 500 error
fix: Wrap Promise.all in try/catch and return graceful error state

issue: All Prisma queries lack try/catch — DB failures cause unhandled promise rejection and raw 500
fix: Wrap queries in try/catch or use error boundary

issue: Active workspace mismatch — activeWorkspaceId destructured but never used, always uses memberships[0]. Shows wrong workspace for multi-workspace users
fix: Use activeWorkspaceId to find the correct workspace: user?.memberships.find(m => m.workspace.id === activeWorkspaceId)?.workspace

issue: try/catch swallows Next.js NEXT_REDIRECT errors thrown by requireAppSession() — returns 500 instead of redirecting
fix: Move requireAppSession outside try block, or use isRedirectError() to re-throw

issue: Cross-organization privilege escalation — admin from workspace A can modify organization B's data
fix: Scope membership query to workspaces belonging to target organization

issue: Missing workspace-level authorization — admin from workspace A can view/post comments on requests in workspace B
fix: Verify admin has membership in requestExists.workspaceId

issue: Authorization bypass — admin role checked globally but never verified user belongs to request's workspace
fix: Verify user's membership includes requestExists.workspaceId

issue: File content never persisted — only metadata saved, uploaded file bytes completely lost
fix: Read file bytes via file.arrayBuffer() and store to storage service

issue: Pagination broken by hardcoded fetchLimit: 200 — in-memory filter on incomplete dataset produces wrong totals and missing records
fix: Increase fetchLimit significantly (e.g., 2000+) or use cursor-based approach

issue: Fake/mock data with Math.random() returned to clients instead of querying real database
fix: Remove Math.random() fabrication, use real data or static descriptive text

issue: Timeline request code fabricated with Date.now().toString().slice(-6) instead of using actual request code from DB
fix: Use log.requestId || undefined, or include actual request code from joined query

issue: Exposing raw error details (error.message) to client — leaks DB connection strings, stack traces
fix: Return generic 'Internal server error' without detail field in production

issue: Race condition — read-modify-write (findFirst -> update) not in transaction. Concurrent PATCH requests cause lost updates and duplicate audit events
fix: Wrap entire read-check-write flow in prisma.$transaction

issue: Missing workspace membership check — user with allowed role in ANY workspace can access chat for ALL requests
fix: Verify session.workspaceId === legalRequest.workspaceId after fetching request

issue: Path traversal via absolute objectKey — path.join ignores storageRoot base if objectKey is absolute path (e.g., /etc/passwd)
fix: Add path.isAbsolute(objectKey) check alongside .. check before calling join

issue: Path traversal check order vulnerability — existsSync called BEFORE .. validation, allowing file existence probing
fix: Move objectKey.includes('..') check BEFORE existsSync call

issue: Error message leak to client — internal file paths and system errors returned in HTTP responses
fix: Return generic error messages; log detailed errors server-side only

issue: Missing ownership verification — any user with allowed role can PATCH/DELETE any annotation regardless of author
fix: Verify existing.authorId === session.userId before allowing modification

issue: isRedirectErr check broken for Next.js — checks e.message instead of e.digest for NEXT_REDIRECT, swallowing redirects
fix: Use e instanceof Error && 'NEXT_REDIRECT' === (e as {digest?: string}).digest

issue: Missing request-level authorization — any user with allowed role can list files of any request, leaking sensitive documents
fix: Verify user is assigned specialist, reviewer, or owner of the specific request

issue: Error detail leaked to client — returns internal error message to user
fix: Remove detail: msg from response; keep for server-side logging only

issue: Missing role-based authorization — JSDoc says coordinator/super_admin but any authenticated user can transition statuses
fix: Verify session.role === 'coordinator' || session.role === 'super_admin' before processing

issue: NaN propagation — parseInt on non-numeric params returns NaN, contaminates skip/take/totalPages
fix: Add || 1 fallback after parseInt to guard against NaN

issue: Status filter overrides exclusion list — query param replaces notIn guard, allowing access to excluded statuses like draft_intake
fix: Check if statusFilter is in EXCLUDED_STATUSES before applying

issue: try/catch swallows NEXT_REDIRECT — unauthenticated users get 500 instead of redirect to sign-in
fix: Move requireAppSession() outside try block or re-throw redirect errors

issue: Exposing raw error details via detail: String(error) — leaks sensitive info
fix: Return generic error message without detail field

issue: Sensitive error details leaked via detail: String(error) — exposes stack traces, DB connection strings
fix: Return generic error message without detail field

issue: Unsafe JSON.parse crashes on invalid metadataSummary — throws unhandled error for every request
fix: Wrap JSON.parse in try/catch, fall back to empty object

issue: Same unsafe JSON.parse in timeline mapping — crashes GET handler on malformed JSON
fix: Wrap JSON.parse in try/catch with fallback to empty object

issue: parseInt returns NaN for non-numeric query params — passing NaN to Prisma skip/take causes unexpected behavior
fix: Validate skip/take are valid non-negative integers: Number.isNaN(rawSkip) ? 0 : rawSkip

issue: Missing workspace-level authorization — admin in workspace A can read/modify/delete workspace B
fix: Verify user has admin membership in target workspace, not just any workspace

issue: PrismaClient instantiated at module scope — new connection pool on every hot-reload, exhausting connections in dev
fix: Use global singleton pattern: const prisma = globalThis.prisma || new PrismaClient()

issue: Catch block silently returns 200 with role:customer on ALL errors (DB failure, auth failure) — potential privilege escalation
fix: Return 500 on server errors so client can distinguish from actual customer role

issue: Error stack traces exposed to client — leaks internal file paths and server architecture
fix: Only include stack trace in development mode (NODE_ENV === 'development')

issue: Unsafe type assertion buffer as ReadableStream — can silently produce garbage if getObject returns unexpected type
fix: Use discriminated check: buffer instanceof Buffer vs buffer instanceof ReadableStream

issue: Role check uses non-existent role 'coordinator_admin' — only super_admin can actually delete files. Intended role is 'coordinator'
fix: Change to membership?.role === 'coordinator' || membership?.role === 'super_admin'

issue: Error matching on error.message.includes('NOT_FOUND'/'PERMISSION') never matches actual error messages — uses wrong strings
fix: Use error instanceof FileNotFoundError / error instanceof FilePermissionError instead

issue: Same broken error-message matching in DELETE handler — NOT_FOUND/PERMISSION matching never works
fix: Use instanceof checks as in GET handler fix

issue: Missing workspace membership authorization — any authenticated user can upload files to arbitrary organizations
fix: Add workspace membership check after authentication before processing upload

issue: Stack trace exposure in production — error.stack returned to client, leaking internal paths
fix: Remove stack from response body in production; log server-side only

issue: transitionRequestStatus called outside transaction — request left in inconsistent state if status transition fails after creation committed
fix: Move status transition into transaction, or add retry/compensation mechanism

issue: Catch returns generic 500 for ALL exceptions including auth failures from requireAppSession() — should return 401
fix: Catch AuthError separately and return 401 instead of 500

issue: Missing authorization check — sender userId not validated against request creator/assignee. Any user can send to any thread
fix: Verify userId === legalRequest.createdById || userId === legalRequest.assignedSpecialistId

issue: Error masking — returns unreadCount: 0 with 500 status. Clients reading only unreadCount will misinterpret server failure
fix: Omit unreadCount from error response; return only error message

issue: Session cookie discarded — signInEmail response with Set-Cookie headers ignored. Client never receives session cookie, all auth fails
fix: Forward signInEmail response or extract Set-Cookie headers into custom NextResponse.json

issue: Entire async handler lacks try-catch — any DB failure causes unhandled promise rejection
fix: Wrap handler body in try-catch and return structured error response

issue: GET handler has no try/catch — any exception results in unhandled 500
fix: Wrap handler body in try/catch, return proper error response

issue: No guard against deactivating last active admin — locks partner out of management
fix: Before deactivating, check activeAdminCount > 0 excluding target member

issue: No guard against deleting last active admin
fix: Before deleting, verify at least one other active admin exists

issue: No guard against demoting last active admin to non-admin role
fix: Check role demotion + isActive change against remaining active admin count

issue: isInternal flag accepted from request body but never persisted to Message model — feature completely broken
fix: Add isInternal: Boolean(isInternal) to prisma.message.create data

issue: Missing file content storage — uploaded file bytes never persisted, only metadata saved
fix: Read file via file.arrayBuffer() and store binary content

issue: Race condition — status read outside transaction enables lost updates. Two concurrent PATCH can both succeed
fix: Move status read inside prisma.$transaction for atomic read-check-write

issue: Critical authorization bypass — when activeWorkspaceId is null/undefined, ?? undefined causes Prisma to omit workspaceId filter entirely
fix: Check for valid activeWorkspaceId before query; return 400 if missing

issue: Race condition in request code generation — count() + 1 is not atomic. Concurrent POSTs produce duplicate REQ-XXXXX codes
fix: Use prisma.$transaction for atomic read+increment, or use timestamp+random suffix

issue: NaN propagation in pagination — parseInt on non-numeric returns NaN, contaminating skip/take
fix: Validate with Number.isFinite() and fall back to defaults before computing skip

issue: UNAUTHENTICATED check is dead code — requireAppSession() calls redirect() which throws NEXT_REDIRECT, never error 'UNAUTHENTICATED'
fix: Remove unreachable 401 branch or re-throw NEXT_REDIRECT errors

issue: Dead code: UNAUTHENTICATED message check never true — requireAppSession uses redirect(), not errors
fix: Re-throw NEXT_REDIRECT errors and remove unreachable 401 branch

issue: Missing workspace-level access control — any authenticated user can download files from any workspace (cross-tenant data leak)
fix: Verify vaultFile.workspaceId === session.activeWorkspaceId before serving file

issue: Authentication bypass via catch-all error handling — empty catch swallows auth failures, returns 200 OK with empty data
fix: Catch and re-throw auth errors; return 401 for auth failures, 500 for others

issue: Catch swallows ALL errors and returns 401 UNAUTHORIZED — masks real server errors as auth failures
fix: Differentiate AuthError (401) from other errors (500) and log appropriately

issue: Hardcoded mock invite data — every invite shows same fake data regardless of real token. Invalid/expired tokens show misleading UI
fix: Replace hardcoded data with fetch to /api/partner/invite/{token} endpoint

issue: CSRF protection unconditionally disabled and secure cookies turned off in ALL environments including production
fix: Gate disableCSRFCheck and useSecureCookies behind process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production'

issue: Control alert metrics computed from current page's events only — misleading security metrics on pages > 1
fix: Use server-side stats endpoint for aggregate metrics instead of client-side page filtering

issue: useEffect dependency on fetchRequests causes refetch of ALL data on any filter change — performance regression and potential infinite loop
fix: Split initial data fetch (once on mount) from filter-dependent fetch

issue: row.customer.split(' ') throws TypeError if customer is null/undefined/empty — crashes entire table
fix: Add null guard: row.customer?.split(' ') || '—'

issue: No null guard on folders prop before .filter() — TypeError if parent passes null/undefined
fix: Use (folders || []).filter(...)

issue: Runtime TypeError when annotation.severity is undefined/null — .charAt(0) called on null
fix: Extract severity with fallback: const severity = annotation.severity || 'info'

issue: Non-atomic assignment + status update — assignment succeeds but status transition fails, leaving inconsistent state silently
fix: Make backend /assign endpoint handle both atomically, or implement rollback on failure

issue: Optimistic message unconditionally removed — if server doesn't return userMessage, user's message disappears from UI
fix: Fall back to optimisticMsg when body.userMessage is absent

issue: Race condition — no abort controller. Rapid filter/page changes cause stale response overwriting newer one
fix: Use AbortController in fetchData, abort previous request on new call

issue: Render side effect — window.__tiptapAnnotationMap assigned directly in render body, not useEffect. Multiple instances conflict
fix: Move to useEffect with cleanup on unmount

issue: JSON.parse called without try-catch on metadataSummary — crashes if API returns already-parsed object
fix: Check typeof log.metadataSummary === 'string' before JSON.parse, fall through otherwise

issue: Fragile border color: ${style.color}20 only works for hex colors — breaks silently on RGB/HSL/named colors
fix: Use borderColor and opacity instead of appending hex alpha to color string

issue: Hardcoded Vietnamese strings in STATUS_STYLE labels break i18n — component uses next-intl but labels hardcoded
fix: Move labels into translations and derive from keys at render time

issue: Client-side status filter with server-side pagination — filter applied on 10 items, not full dataset. Pagination broken
fix: Pass statusFilter to API as query parameter in fetchData

issue: Status filter applied client-side on paginated data — only filters 10 items per page, not full dataset
fix: Send statusFilter to API as query parameter instead of client-side filtering

issue: Missing validation for unknown current status — nextStatus stays empty, causes invalid API call with status: ''
fix: Add else branch to disable confirm button or show error for unknown statuses

issue: Component named 'UserPagination' but has no page navigation controls — only page size selector. Users cannot change pages
fix: Add prev/next buttons or page number navigation

issue: SEED_USERS with hardcoded credentials and Quick Login buttons rendered in production with no environment gate
fix: Gate SEED_USERS behind process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development'

issue: Unsafe type assertion stepNumber as 1|2|3|4|5 — if totalSteps !== 5, out-of-range numbers silently cast
fix: Add runtime guard: stepNumber >= 1 && stepNumber <= totalSteps before cast

issue: Stuck loading state when zero cases — isLoading initialized as allCases.length === 0 and never set to false. Empty state shows skeleton forever
fix: Derive loading from explicit fetch lifecycle, not absence of data

issue: Null/undefined crash — cases.filter() throws TypeError if cases is undefined/null at runtime
fix: Use (cases || []).filter(...)

issue: All nav hrefs hardcoded with '/vi/' locale prefix — users on other locales redirect to Vietnamese pages
fix: Use locale prop to construct URLs: /${locale}/admin/dashboard

issue: Hardcoded /vi/sign-in in logout redirect — breaks locale experience for non-Vietnamese users
fix: Use locale variable to construct signInPath dynamically

issue: NaN crash — empty string senderId leads to NaN index, accessing SENDER_COLORS[NaN] returns undefined
fix: Return fallback color if !senderId

issue: Polling concurrency — setInterval fires overlapping requests if API is slow, causing duplicate messages
fix: Use setTimeout chaining with isPolling guard instead of setInterval

issue: Both handleStatusToggle and handleRemoveMember re-throw errors after catching, causing unhandled rejections
fix: Remove re-throw; show toast only

issue: Missing HTTP error handling — response.ok not checked, errors silently parsed as JSON
fix: Check response.ok before parsing; set error state on failure

issue: Race condition on error — setSelectedLocale(currentLocale) reverts to stale prop, overwrites successful later change
fix: Track latest requested locale with ref; only revert if latest request matches

issue: Race condition — rapid toggles cause lost updates. Revert uses stale previousPreferences snapshot
fix: Use per-key pending map or atomic queue to serialize updates

issue: Uncontrolled mode broken — checked=false default makes isControlled always true. Toggle stuck at false in uncontrolled mode
fix: Remove default value from destructured param, use checked ?? false as initial state

issue: Clicking menu item causes immediate reopen due to event bubbling to container toggle
fix: Add e.stopPropagation() in handleItemClick

issue: Negative count crashes — Array.from with negative length throws RangeError
fix: Use Math.max(0, count) for array length

issue: Accessibility — onClick button has no onKeyDown handler. Keyboard users cannot activate
fix: Add onKeyDown for Enter/Space keys per WAI-ARIA guidelines

issue: Missing type="button" — renders as type="submit" by default, triggering unintended form submissions
fix: Add type="button" explicitly to <Comp>

issue: Whitespace-only names cause TypeError — name.split(' ') produces empty strings, parts[0][0] is undefined
fix: Trim name first, check trimmed.length > 0, guard against empty split parts

issue: upsert update clause only sets isActive: true but never updates role — role change silently lost
fix: Add role: input.role to the update object in upsert

issue: Chapter numbering swapped — Chương VIII and IX reversed, causing AI to reference wrong chapter numbers
fix: Swap Chương VIII (Nhóm công ty) and Chương IX (Tổ chức lại, giải thể)

issue: Anthropic API responses parsed incorrectly — looks for data.choices (OpenAI format) instead of data.content (Anthropic format). All Anthropic calls silently return empty
fix: Branch on request.model.provider === 'anthropic' to parse top-level content array

issue: execute() and executeStream() call LLM without try/catch — network errors/timeouts cause unhandled rejection
fix: Wrap LLM call in try/catch, return graceful error result on failure

issue: Prompt injection vulnerability — user inputs directly interpolated without sanitization
fix: Sanitize inputs by wrapping in delimiters, stripping prompt-like patterns

issue: Prompt injection via documentContent — user-uploaded documents can contain instruction injection payloads
fix: Wrap documentContent in delimiters with explicit data-only instruction

issue: Prompt injection via documentContent — no escaping or delimiters on user content
fix: Wrap in XML tags <document>...</document> with explicit instruction boundary

issue: Prompt injection — user input unsanitized, regex-based {{#if}} exploitable via {{/if}} injection
fix: Sanitize user inputs and wrap in delimiters

issue: JSON parsing before response.ok check breaks retry — SyntaxError on HTML error pages kills retry on 502/503/504
fix: Move response.json() after response.ok check, wrap JSON parse in try-catch

issue: vaultApi.upload bypasses apiClient — uses raw fetch skipping centralized auth headers, CSRF, interceptors
fix: Use apiClient.post('/api/vault/upload', formData) instead of raw fetch

issue: Case-insensitive search broken — lowercased search term but Prisma contains is case-sensitive by default (SQLite)
fix: Add mode: 'insensitive' to each contains filter (if DB supports it)

issue: Calling .trim() on potentially undefined/null values throws TypeError instead of descriptive error
fix: Add null guard: !input.workspaceId?.trim()

issue: Case-insensitive regex (gi flag) mismatches case-sensitive SECTION_META lookup — vấn đề/Issue variants fail
fix: Normalize captured label to canonical form via case-insensitive comparison

issue: Unsafe Unicode range [a-đ] spans 176 characters including {, |, }, ~, DEL — massive false positive bullet point matching
fix: Use [a-dđ] instead of [a-đ] to match only Vietnamese point labels

issue: Race condition — existingCount + 1 not atomic. Concurrent createTemplate produces duplicate versions
fix: Wrap in prisma.$transaction or use unique constraint with retry

issue: Race condition — maxVersion aggregate not atomic. Concurrent createNewVersion produces duplicate version numbers
fix: Wrap in prisma.$transaction

issue: Authorization bypass when externalTx provided — RBAC canAccessRequest check skipped entirely
fix: Always perform RBAC check regardless of transaction context; externalTx only about tx scope

issue: formatDateTime calls toLocaleDateString instead of toLocaleString — time components silently ignored, returns only date
fix: Change to d.toLocaleString(...)

issue: Double status transition to 'triage' for unsupported matter types — second transition to same status always fails
fix: For unsupported matters, transition to 'pending_triage' instead of 'triage'

issue: File content never stored — file.arrayBuffer() never called, only metadata saved. Whole upload feature non-functional
fix: Call await input.file.arrayBuffer() and store binary content to storage backend

issue: Role authorization block is empty — when options.roles specified, enters if block but performs NO check. Silent security bypass
fix: Implement role verification: check session.user.roles against options.roles

issue: Global PrismaClient instantiation in middleware — new instance each cold start, connection pool exhaustion under load
fix: Use singleton via shared lib/db module (globalThis pattern)

issue: Prisma Client incompatible with Edge Runtime — Node.js APIs (fs, net, tls) not available in Edge
fix: Export const runtime = 'nodejs' or extract DB queries to Route Handler via fetch

issue: req.headers.set() does NOT propagate headers to downstream handlers in Next.js middleware
fix: Use NextResponse.next({ request: { headers: new Headers(req.headers) } })

issue: olderThanSevenDays computed from first 100 requests (take: 100) not full dataset — misleading metric
fix: Use separate prisma.legalRequest.count() query against full filtered set

issue: Information leakage — distinct error messages reveal resource existence (Not found vs Permission denied)
fix: Return uniform error message for both cases to prevent enumeration

issue: Same information leakage in delete method — reveals whether resource exists
fix: Return uniform error message

issue: Race condition — findFirst-then-create not safe under READ COMMITTED. Concurrent startReview creates duplicate reviews
fix: Add unique index on (documentVersionId, reviewerId) and use upsert

issue: Missing authorization check — upsertMatterType doesn't verify admin privileges. Any authenticated user can create/modify matter types
fix: Add requireRoutingAdmin call with actorId parameter

issue: Missing authorization check — upsertRoutingCapability doesn't verify admin privileges
fix: Add requireRoutingAdmin call with actorId parameter

issue: Security bypass — pathname.includes(PATH) causes /admin/sign-in-log to match /sign-in, /admin/auth-bypass to match /auth
fix: Remove || pathname.includes(p); use only startsWith

issue: Race condition — $transaction doesn't prevent concurrent create of multiple isCurrent:true assignments
fix: Use SELECT FOR UPDATE locking or partial unique index on (requestId, kind) WHERE isCurrent=true

issue: partnerLogin returns full User object with potentially sensitive fields like passwordHash — credential exposure
fix: Destructure to exclude passwordHash/hashedPassword from response

issue: user.email.toLowerCase() called without null check — TypeError if user.email is null
fix: Add guard: !user.email || user.email.toLowerCase() !== invite.email.toLowerCase()

issue: Authorization bypass — checkPartnerFullAccess receives partnerId but never uses it. Returns true if ANY partner has access
fix: Add partnerId filter to the Prisma query

issue: Soft-deleted requests still retrievable by ID — getRequestById doesn't filter deletedAt: null
fix: Add deletedAt: null to where clause

issue: Soft-delete bypass — getVaultFileById doesn't filter deletedAt: null. Deleted files remain accessible
fix: Add deletedAt: null to where clause, use findFirst instead of findUnique

issue: Database marked as migrated to S3 without actually uploading files — permanent data loss if local storage decommissioned
fix: Gate DB update behind actual S3 upload; add --unsafe flag requiring confirmation

issue: provider.initialize() is async but not awaited — StorageService returned before directories ready. Immediate operations fail
fix: await provider.initialize() before returning storageService

issue: Orphaned storage objects on DB failure — upload succeeds before DB insert, leaving unreferenced objects if DB fails
fix: Create DB record first as 'pending', upload, then update status to 'uploaded'

issue: Permanent data loss — storage object deleted but DB only soft-deleted. Misleading state: DB says recoverable but file gone
fix: Choose: true soft-delete (don't delete storage) or hard-delete (remove DB record too)

issue: Negative slice length when extension >= 200 chars — produces name exceeding 200-char limit
fix: Use Math.max(0, 200 - ext.length) and handle ext.length >= 200 case separately

issue: Broken parseObjectKey for requests/* paths — parts.length >= 8 should be >= 7. Keys with exactly 7 parts never match
fix: Change to parts.length >= 7 for requests/* path parsing

issue: super_admin bypass broken — actor object built only from workspace memberships. super_admin not in workspace gets empty roles, canAccessRequest fails
fix: Fetch user's global role in addition to workspace roles when constructing actor

issue: Missing i18n validation keys — common login errors (accountLocked, tooManyAttempts) missing, fall back to genericError masking UX flows
fix: Add missing Auth validation keys for accountLocked and tooManyAttempts

issue: Security bypass — pathname.includes(p) matches substrings anywhere. /admin/sign-in matches /sign-in, granting unauthenticated public access
fix: Remove || pathname.includes(p); use only startsWith

issue: OKLCH color in shadow tokens has poor/unknown browser support — shadows may silently fall back to transparent
fix: Use rgba fallback (e.g., rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)) for broad browser support

issue: Hardcoded test credentials 'test@example.com' / 'testpassword123' in source code
fix: Use process.env.TEST_USER_EMAIL and process.env.TEST_USER_PASSWORD

issue: Missing fixture file — ./tests/e2e/fixtures/large-file.pdf does not exist. Test will fail at runtime
fix: Create fixture file or generate large file on-the-fly in test setup

issue: Hardcoded plaintext password 'Demo@123456' in bcrypt.hash call
fix: Use process.env.ADMIN_RESET_PASSWORD with validation; exit if not set

issue: Unconditionally overwrites ALL credential accounts to single password hash — destroys every user's original credential
fix: Add WHERE clause to scope to specific user/admin, or add safety guard with confirmation prompt

issue: __dirname is not defined in ESM modules. If project is ESM, throws ReferenceError crashing Vitest
fix: Use import.meta.dirname (Node 21.2+) or fileURLToPath(import.meta.url) for ESM compatibility
